title: Myntra Wishlist Conversion Strategy
note: External PM research, not first-party Myntra data. Example funnel rates in the share (e.g. 12% WPC) are illustrative — do not treat as measured.
north_star: 30-day wishlist purchase conversion: users who add ≥1 item who purchase ≥1 wishlisted item within 30 days. Do not optimize wishlist additions.
problem_statement: High-intent users lack decision support between I like this and I am confident enough to buy this. Do not assume they forgot the list.

chunks.title: H1 Decision uncertainty
chunks.text: User thought: I like it, but I am not sure. Barrier: size, fit, color, quality. Segment: Ready but Hesitating — 1–3 products, frequent revisits, views size chart/reviews, has purchased similar before, still does not buy. Opportunity: remove friction.

chunks.title: H2 Timing
chunks.text: User thought: I want it, but not right now. Barrier: no immediate need. Segment: Wait and Watch — adds, does not revisit immediately, returns after several days, checks price/availability. Opportunity: useful product-change information, not a coupon.

chunks.title: H3 Price or value uncertainty
chunks.text: User thought: I will wait and see. Barrier: waiting for price movement. Constraint: no coupons, discounts, cashback, coins, or price-based rewards.

chunks.title: H4 Choice overload
chunks.text: User thought: I will decide later. Barrier: too many wishlist items. Segment: Comparison Shopper — 10–30 similar products, same category/brand, rarely purchases from wishlist. Opportunity: help them narrow choices with in-list comparison.

chunks.title: H5 Product availability
chunks.text: User thought: I will buy it when I need it. Barrier: stock or size unavailable. Segment: Availability Blocked. Opportunity: recovery — size back in stock, genuine inventory signals.

chunks.title: Passive saver
chunks.text: Hundreds of wishlist items, rarely opens wishlist, low purchase intent. The list is a storage bucket. Opportunity: re-engagement and organization — do not force conversion of moodboarders.

chunks.title: Smart Wishlist MVP
chunks.text: Turn the wishlist from storage into a decision assistant. Surface genuine signals only: people bought this recently, price changed since save, limited sizes, ratings, similar saved items. Constraint: no fake urgency, no monetary incentive.

chunks.title: In-wishlist comparison
chunks.text: Compare 2–4 saved products in the same category on rating, reviews, fit, material, delivery, returns. Attacks choice paralysis. Priority: medium-high impact, high confidence, medium effort.

chunks.title: Fit and decision support
chunks.text: If path is wishlist → size chart → reviews → exit: surface based on previous purchases you usually buy M in this brand. Size-exchange reassurance, not a discount. Priority: high impact, medium confidence, medium effort.

chunks.title: Information-value reminders
chunks.text: Not you have items in your wishlist. Trigger only on meaningful change: your size is back, almost out of stock in your size, you viewed this 3 times — compare with other saved jackets.

chunks.title: A/B Smart Wishlist
chunks.text: Control: existing wishlist. Treatment: decision-support signals. Primary: 30-day wishlist purchase conversion. Secondary: revisit rate, wishlist-to-cart, wishlist-to-PDP, purchase frequency. Guardrails: notification opt-out, uninstall, returns/cancellations, incrementality (not pull-forward of people who would have bought anyway).

chunks.title: Core PM insight
chunks.text: Do not optimize the wishlist. Optimize the user's decision. Capture intent → understand hesitation → remove uncertainty → trigger action. Do not start with an AI chatbot.

chunks.title: No monetary incentives
chunks.text: Cannot use coupons, discounts, cashback, coins, extra Myntra points, or price-based rewards. Strategy: reduce uncertainty + reduce decision effort + create useful (genuine) urgency only.

chunks.title: How to find the real leakage
chunks.text: Quant: wishlist funnel (view → add → revisit → PDP → cart → checkout → purchase) cut by category, price, tenure, list size. Qual: interview purchased vs never-purchased vs repeat-revisit vs OOS. In-app survey after repeat visits: still deciding / waiting / fit / compare / quality / size unavailable. Example funnel rates in the share are illustrative, not measured.

chunks.title: Why buy now decision card
chunks.text: On a wishlisted PDP, surface only genuine signals: your size is available, rating and review count, easy returns, delivery date. No fake urgency. Goal: confidence, not a coupon.
